I'm putting together a simple dashboard page for a small internal tool and need help with both the UI references and the architecture drawing.  
    Could you find a clean icon that represents a "statistics overview", show me the documentation and a couple of examples for the Ant Design Card component, and then generate a small architecture diagram that shows:  
    - a frontend module using that Card component,  
    - a backend API service,  
    - and a data storage layer?  
    Keep the diagram high-level.
answer:
Here's everything you need, in three parts. --- ## 1. Icon for "statistics overview" **Recommended: `analytics-03`** — a bar‑chart/analytics glyph. Its tags include `analytics`, `bar chart`, `statistics`, `data`, `chart`, `report`, `dashboard`, `metrics` — exactly the "statistics overview" meaning. I checked its availability across styles and the glyph `󱖿` (decimal `988607`) is returned for all 10 styles: `stroke-rounded`, `stroke-standard`, `stroke-sharp`, `solid-rounded`, `solid-standard`, `solid-sharp`, `bulk-rounded`, `duotone-rounded`, `duotone-standard`, `twotone-rounded`. So you can match whatever stroke/fill language the rest of your icon set uses. **React usage:** ```bash npm install @hugeicons/react @hugeicons/core-free-icons ``` ```tsx import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react'; import { Analytics03Icon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons'; function StatCardHeader() { return ; } ``` **Good alternatives** (all in the `business`/`dashboard` categories, all tagged with statistics/overview/dashboard): | Icon | Character | |---|---| | `chart-analysis` | Line/trend analysis of data | | `analytics-01` / `analytics-02` | Classic bar-chart overview | | `analytics-up` | Bar chart with upward trend — nice for "growth" KPIs | | `layout-dashboard` | Grid of widgets — better for a dashboard nav item than a stat card | A common pattern: `analytics-03` inside the Card title/`extra` slot, e.g. ` Overview}>`. --- ## 2. Ant Design Card — docs and examples ### When to use The most basic card container. Holds text, lists, images, paragraphs — commonly used on **admin overview pages** (which is your case). ### API (the props that matter for a dashboard) ```jsx Card content ``` | Prop | Description | Type | Default | Version | |---|---|---|---|---| | `title` | Card title | ReactNode | - | | | `extra` | Top-right action area | ReactNode | - | | | `actions` | Action group at card bottom | Array<ReactNode> | - | | | `loading` | Show skeleton placeholder while loading | boolean | false | | | `hoverable` | Lift on hover | boolean | false | | | `size` | Card size | `default` \| `small` | `default` | | | `cover` | Card cover | ReactNode | - | | | `variant` | Visual variant | `outlined` \| `borderless` | `outlined` | **5.24.0** | | ~~`bordered`~~ | Use `variant` instead | boolean | true | deprecated | | `tabList` / `activeTabKey` / `onTabChange` | Tabs inside the card | TabItemType[] / string / (key) => void | - | | | `classNames` / `styles` | Customize semantic DOM parts (object or function) | Record<SemanticDOM, ...> | - | | > ⚠️ Version note: `variant` requires **antd ≥ 5.24.0**. On older versions you'd use the now-deprecated `bordered={false}`. Sub-components: **`Card.Meta`** (`avatar`, `title`, `description`) and **`Card.Grid`** (`className`, `hoverable` default true, `style`). ### Example A — Grid cards (the canonical "system overview" layout) This is the pattern the docs explicitly recommend for overview pages, and it maps directly onto a stats dashboard. ```tsx import React from 'react'; import { Card, Col, Row } from 'antd'; const App: React.FC = () => ( Card content Card content Card content ); export default App; ``` ### Example B — Typical card with header action + content ```tsx import React from 'react'; import { Card, Space } from 'antd'; const App: React.FC = () => ( More} style={{ width: 300 }}>

Architecture diagram (high-level) Generated and syntax-validated as SVG: ![PlantUML Diagram](https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/svg/LP11JyCm38Nl-HLMJt2ek7EOrXAX5KrGgTi9E7YjrqPBayhnDY74VyS5f8sR_TxtdX8lao3BSVGc7LoOa764DevJ31IaaGzFmDGAXjxJ5P86xEBPXHxsw1CP8quKjPY6NKJk88ULwuTyJIVoK70xED6Q8oiwONl0dY1xv1Y4GfV1fm5ulOHhjT_2JH44B2NN1tXG-VOTCC6sCbzN7QKEbugYhg0XFhcMVc3T_z4M1N_HJgSTfZyD6eciH3Q7R3bdjXNa-M9kW7jORJOrtC5Jy_9iPcLsRAa64tPgd5c_PvRw4BtaDm00) Source, so you can tweak labels: ```plantuml @startuml skinparam componentStyle rectangle skinparam shadowing false title Dashboard - High-Level Architecture package "Frontend" { [Dashboard Page\n(Ant Design Card)] as UI } package "Backend" { [API Service] as API } package "Data" { database "Data Storage" as DB } UI --> API : HTTP / JSON API --> DB : read / write @enduml ``` Three boxes, two arrows — intentionally no auth layer, cache, or queue, so it stays a sketch rather than an implementation diagram. If you later want it to grow, the natural next additions are an auth/identity box in front of the API and a cache between API and storage.

Card 组件的文档：
## 何时使用
最基础的卡片容器，可承载文字、列表、图片、段落，常用于后台概览页面。
## API
```jsx
<Card title="卡片标题">卡片内容</Card>
```
| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | 版本 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| actions | 卡片操作组，位置在卡片底部 | Array<ReactNode> | - |  |
| activeTabKey | 当前激活页签的 key | string | - |  |
| ~~bordered~~ | 是否有边框, 请使用 `variant` 替换 | boolean | true |  |
| variant | 形态变体 | `outlined` \| `borderless` \| | `outlined` | 5.24.0 |
| classNames | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> | - |  |
| cover | 卡片封面 | ReactNode | - |  |
| defaultActiveTabKey | 初始化选中页签的 key，如果没有设置 activeTabKey | string | `第一个页签的 key` |  |
| extra | 卡片右上角的操作区域 | ReactNode | - |  |
| hoverable | 鼠标移过时可浮起 | boolean | false |  |
| loading | 当卡片内容还在加载中时，可以用 loading 展示一个占位 | boolean | false |  |
| size | card 的尺寸 | `default` \| `small` | `default` |  |
| tabBarExtraContent | tab bar 上额外的元素 | ReactNode | - |  |
| tabList | 页签标题列表 | [TabItemType](/components/tabs-cn#tabitemtype)[] | - |  |
| tabProps | [Tabs](/components/tabs-cn#tabs) | - | - |  |
| title | 卡片标题 | ReactNode | - |  |
| type | 卡片类型，可设置为 `inner` 或 不设置 | string | - |  |
| styles | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> | - |  |
| onTabChange | 页签切换的回调 | (key) => void | - |  |
### Card.Grid
| 参数      | 说明                   | 类型          | 默认值 | 版本 |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------- | ------ | ---- |
| className | 网格容器类名           | string        | -      |      |
| hoverable | 鼠标移过时可浮起       | boolean       | true   |      |
| style     | 定义网格容器类名的样式 | CSSProperties | -      |      |
### Card.Meta
| 参数        | 说明               | 类型          | 默认值 | 版本 |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ------------- | ------ | ---- |
| avatar      | 头像/图标          | ReactNode     | -      |      |
| className   | 容器类名           | string        | -      |      |
| description | 描述内容           | ReactNode     | -      |      |
| style       | 定义容器类名的样式 | CSSProperties | -      |      |
| title       | 标题内容           | ReactNode     | -      |      |

如有版本说明需要提醒用户需要使用某个版本及以上的版本
